svg.title: How the Hephaestus codebase fits together
svg.desc: Four layers. Front doors: the terminal and web consoles in apps/, and the programs you run, hephaestus and heph, plus the MCP gateway and remote worker. The engine: hephaestusd in hephaestus-control, the only writer. Capabilities: hephaestus-genome turns World and Genome files into sealed objects; hephaestus-runtime runs agents in locked sandboxes; hephaestus-experience records what happened with secrets scrubbed; hephaestus-arena runs fair paired comparisons. Foundation: hephaestus-ledger, the chained record and file store; hephaestus-core, the Laws and shared vocabulary. Standalone: hephaestus-senate, the debate tool, which needs none of the rest. Code only depends on its own layer or the layers below.
